description:
Use this when the user wants to find an editing style other creators share: "show me community presets", "is
        there a gaming preset", "what podcast looks can I use", "popular edit styles". query: words that must all appear
        in a preset's name, creator, description or category. category: a category name such as hype or podcast (the
        answer lists them). limit: 1-50, default 20. Each preset says what it does (its clips, length and the parts of
        the look it carries), how many people used it, whether it needs Premium, and the id of its preview in RipClip.
        Not for: the user's own templates (edit_catalog kind templates) or clipping presets (list_clipping_presets).
        Free and read only. Next: add_preset with a preset_id.
name: browse_presets
title: Browse community presets
